prompt:
Hi, I'm Grace from the Ops team. I need to find the cheapest flights from Chengdu to Sanya for our team offsite. We have 8 people traveling and need to keep it under ¥1,200 per person one-way. Our team is flexible — they can depart anytime between November 8th and November 14th, 2025, and they don't mind red-eye or connecting flights if it saves money.

Can you search for the best budget options and save the full results to a file called **flight_report.md**? Make sure every option has a link so we can actually book it. Also, since the team is flexible on timing, please also check if there are any especially cheap late-night flights we should know about.

Thanks!
